sigmarsComet.description: Add 2 recharge tokens to every Bright Order spell in your hand, except 1 of your choice.

conservative.requirements: 6 power. If you are engaged with an enemy, add {Dc} to your dice pool. Special: You may not add or remove more than 2 recharge tokens from any one spell. If you add recharge tokens to an spell in your hand, it does not count as successfully cast.
